Team — attaching the post-event field report from Athena Conf and a preliminary pipeline rollup. High level: total influenced pipeline shown in the report is $210,400 (23 leads), but HubSpot export I pulled yesterday only shows $118,900 tied directly to the campaign. I want to get this reconciled for the Q1 marketing KPIs and the JE we put in for partner credits.

- Laura/Ben: can you validate the rules you want us to use to attribute credit (first touch vs. multi-touch vs. campaign-only)? I flagged 18 leads that are ambiguous.

- External: events@confhub.com / Allison — any notes/photos or lead scan exports you have would help.

Attachments: Q1-Field-Event-Report-AthenaConf.xlsx (summary + lead list), lead_photos_athena.zip (photos and badges).

I propose we meet 30m after attachments are reconciled to sign off.

—Sergio

Sergio — thanks for the deck. I reviewed the summary and the breakdown doesn't match our HubSpot report. Specifics:
- The report lists 7 SQLs attributed to the event; HubSpot shows 3 marked as SQL and 2 marked as MQL (same contacts).
- The total ARR contribution in your sheet ($210,400) seems to include two late-stage opps that closed in Feb but were only tagged to the event after the fact.

Can you provide a row-level mapping (report row -> HubSpot contact ID -> activity timestamp)? I need that to reconcile the Q1 marketing credit and to justify the partner credits. If we can't map 1:1 for at least 80% of the dollar amount, we should mark the remainder as "influenced - unverified."

Also CC'ing Ben because this may be an attribution/UTM issue on the campaign pages.

—Laura
VP, Revenue Operations

Looping in ops notes: last quarter we had an attribution bug where campaign UTM_source was being merged with organic when the lead importer didn't set the campaign field. That led to double counting in a couple of sheets. My hypothesis: the $210k number is including both event campaign and later direct-opportunity retro-tags (post-close tagging).

Vivek — can you confirm which Campaign ID the HubSpot export is tied to? If the sheet Sergio sent is campaign-agnostic (the field team manually added source="AthenaConf"), we need to prefer HubSpot campaign_id for the official KPI. I've added a quick checklist in the Drive doc: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/Events/AthenaConf/Checklist

—Ben
Senior Growth Ops Manager

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Athena Conf — field report + preliminary pipeline

Attaching the raw HubSpot export you requested (hubspot_export_athena_20260324.csv). Notes on the export:
- Export includes contact_id, first_conversion_event, first_touch_utm_medium, campaign_id, deal_amount, and activity_timestamp.
- Campaign ID used for the event is 9876. There are 23 contacts in the export tied to campaign_id 9876. Total deal_amount for those contacts is $118,900.
- Two of the high-dollar deals that Sergio included are not campaign_id=9876; they have campaign_id null and were retro-tagged last week by an AE (notes indicate "associate to AthenaConf").

My recommendation: for reporting, mark campaign_id=9876 rows as "directly attributed." For rows with campaign_id null but with event scan present and meeting notes attached, mark as "influenced - evidence provided" and move to a secondary bucket. I'll flag the retro-tagged opps in the export with a comment column.

—Vivek
Head of Revenue Systems

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Allison Reed <allison.reed@acmewidget.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Athena Conf — field report + preliminary pipeline

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. I did the row-level matching and attached a cleaned sheet (Q1-Field-Event-Report-AthenaConf.xlsx, tab "reconciled"). Summary of the reconciliation logic I used:
- Direct attribution: campaign_id=9876 AND first_conversion_event within 7 days of event = include at full credit.
- Influenced-verified: campaign_id null but event scan present and meeting notes attached = 50% credit.
- Retro-tagged closed-won that were associated after close = marked as "audit-flag" and excluded from KPI totals.

Reconciled totals (final for KPI):
- Directly attributed pipeline: $86,700 (11 contacts)
- Influenced-verified pipeline: $33,200 (6 contacts, 50% credit applied)
- Audit-flag / excluded: $90,500 (retro-tagged closed-won)
- Report total (for internal field marketing visibility): $210,400 (same as earlier number, but note how we split it above)

Action: Laura — please confirm you accept the reconciliation buckets for Q1 reporting. If yes I will update the event ledger and close the JIRA SUP-9821. If not, let's list specific rows you want re-examined.

—Sergio
Director, Field Marketing

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Athena Conf — field report + preliminary pipeline

Ack and thanks — that reconciliation method is reasonable. For the Q1 KPI rollup we'll treat the $86,700 as primary credit and $33,200 as influenced (70/30 split for internal crediting between Field Marketing and SDRs). The $90,500 audit-flagged amount will be excluded from marketing-sourced pipeline for Q1 and revisited with Finance if it affects any commission calculations.

Ben/Vivek — please propagate the final attribution tags into HubSpot (campaign_id=9876 for the directs, custom property "influenced_verified"=true for the secondary bucket). Sergio — once that's done file the final sheet in the Drive link and close the JIRA ticket.

—Laura
VP, Revenue Operations
